svg.title: Figure 4-1. What the SoC can ask the safety MCU to do (WP-S-05 §4.2)
svg.desc: 28 control requests of WP-S-05 §4.2. 0xa8 read microsecond timer: needed allow; today none. 0xb0 set IR power: needed allow; today none. 0xb1 / 0xb2 fan power / rpm: needed allow; today none. 0xb5 deep sleep: needed absent; today ALLOW_DEBUG only. 0xb6 read debug log: needed allow; today none. 0xc0 reset comms buffers: needed allow (logged); today none. 0xc1, 0xc3, 0xd0, 0xd3, 0xd4, 0xd6, 0xdd read HW type, UID, serial, signature, version, packet versions: needed allow; today none. 0xc2 CAN health: needed allow; today bounds-checked. 0xc4 interrupt call rate: needed allow; today bounds-checked. 0xc5 drive relay / ignition relay: needed reject; today none (no gate). 0xc6 read SoC GPIO: needed allow; today none. 0xd1 bootloader (param 0) / softloader (param 1): needed reject param 1 in car mode; today param 0 ALLOW_DEBUG; param 1 none (no gate). 0xd2 health packet: needed allow; today none. 0xd8 MCU reset: needed allow (reset is safe if TSR-502 holds); today none. 0xdb OBD CAN multiplexing: needed reject; today none (no gate). 0xdc set safety mode and parameter: needed only reference modes; de-escalation only once TOYOTA active; today none (no gate). 0xde CAN bit rate: needed reject; today speed whitelist only. 0xdf alternative experience: needed keep; release value must be 0; today only outside car modes. 0xe5 CAN loopback: needed reject; today none (no gate). 0xe6 clock-source timer parameters: needed reject; today none (no gate). 0xe7 power save: needed reject while authority possible; today none (no gate). 0xe8 CAN-FD auto switching: needed reject; bounds-check; today none (no gate). 0xf1 clear CAN queues: needed reject in car mode; today bus index checked. 0xf3 heartbeat, param1 = engaged: needed carry control-loop evidence; today none (no gate). 0xf6 siren enable: needed allow; today none. 0xf8 disable heartbeat checks: needed keep; today refused in car modes. 0xf9, 0xfc CAN-FD data rate / non-ISO: needed reject; today bus index checked. 0xfb deep sleep (host panda.cc): needed —; today not handled in application (falls to default).
svg.text: Figure 4-1 · What the SoC can ask the safety MCU to do
The 28 control requests of §4.2 by the treatment a release build needs in a car mode, each with its effect and its gating at the baseline: 9 that must be refused or limited have no gate today
Must be refused in a car mode, or absent from release builds (11)
can release or engage relay at any time
today: param 0 ALLOW_DEBUG; param 1 none · needed:
today: speed whitelist only · needed: reject
today: none · needed: reject while authority possible
today: bus index checked · needed: reject in car mode
today: bus index checked · needed: reject
today: none · needed: only reference modes; de-escalation
today: only outside car modes · needed: keep; release value
today: none · needed: carry control-loop evidence
today: refused in car modes · needed: keep
Allowed: no effect on safety, or the effect is itself safe (12)
may drop a partial CAN packet
read HW type, UID, serial, signature, version,
today: not handled in application (falls to default)
no gate today: the SoC can use it now in any mode
gated today, but not yet as required
The table and figure describe the baseline; the reference build adds the mode lock of TSR-512.
Generated by fig_s05_requests.py from WP-S-05 §4.2; the release whitelist per mode is OI-3.

g.text: Terms: CAN controller area network: the vehicle's data bus · DM driver monitoring · GPIO general-purpose input/output pin · HW hardware · IR infrared · IRQ interrupt request · MCU microcontroller: the panda safety

processor (STM32H7) · OBD on-board diagnostics port · OI-nn open item of the document it appears in · SILENT the panda's safety mode that sends nothing · SoC system on chip: the comma device's main processor,

running openpilot (QM) · SOTIF safety of the intended functionality (ISO 21448): hazards with nothing failing · SS-nn safe state (FSC §6): SS-L lateral, SS-G longitudinal, SS-S envelope silent · TOYOTA the panda's

Toyota car mode (parameter 73 in the reference build) · TSR-nn technical safety requirement (WP-S-02) · UID unique identifier of the chip · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C
concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
